tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa la bstod pa dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ dro ha si shasatra bhū mi paṇḍu sya dharma pā la shukla mā ra kī lar rakṣa kā li se na tri ya stott+ra shrī dzwa la dāe wa dundu bhi nā ma gu ru badzra ku ma ra shtsa dwai ma tri kā la dza ya mā satri ya na maḥ bod skad du/ 'khon ston sa skya pa'i chos skyong dkar bdud phur srung nag mo sde gsum la bstod pa dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu dang gnyis su med pa'i dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di'i tshig rkang lnga la gzhan yang ma ring mo'i dbyangs rol 'jug dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong ma'i phyag len la dkar mo'i bskang ba rgyas bsdus kyi bstod par gzhan yang ma 'bring gung 'jug par mdzad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /bhyoḥ srid zhi kun khyab 'khor 'das yum/ /snang srid ma mo'i bdag mo ni/ /sgrib gnyis spangs pas sku mdog dkar/ /chos dbyings rnam dag zhal dkyil zlum/ /yon tan rab rdzogs ral pa'i thod/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum g.yo/ /bdud dpung zil gnon smin ma bsdus/ /'gro kun yid 'phrog mdzes pa'i shangs/ /rdo rje'i tshig 'dzin snyan shal ring / /chos kun ro gcig gyur pa'i zhal/ /rig 'dzin dga' ba'i 'dzum bag g.yo/ /skye 'chi rtsad gcod mche ba gtsigs/ /bde chen ro bcud myangs pa'i ljags/ /chos kun 'doms pa dpal gyi mgul/ /ye shes mdzod 'dzin sku stod rgyas/ /grub gnyis stsol ba'i 'o 'dzin mtho/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug phyag gnyis ma/ /dpal kun bskyed pa'i lto ba zlum/ /dga' bzhi ster ba'i padma rgyas/ /gzung 'dzin mtha' gnon zhabs zung ldan/ /'gro ba'i nad sogs zhi ba'i phyir/ /rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa' 'dzin/ /zhi ba'i thugs ldan dar dkar gsol/

/rnam par sgeg mdzad ma la bstod/ /tshe dpal rigs sogs rgyas pa'i phyir/ /nyi zla'i dbu rgyan do shal byas/ /dprog zhu snyan rgyan mgul rgyan do shal phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/༈ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /srid gsum dpal 'bar ma la bstod/ /brtan g.yo dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs dar sham dmar/༈ dpal gyi bstan skyong ma las gangs dkar mdog can sham thabs can gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na mi 'gal te/ 'jam mgon de nyid kyi sku dus la bzhengs par mdzad pa'i bris thang phal cher la dmar por snang ba'i phyir ro/ /rjes chags cung zad 'gyings pa'i tshul/ /snod bcud yid 'phrog ma la bstod/ /bgegs sogs gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ /dkar khras dbu mching snyan rgyan/ dmar khras mgul rgyan/ ljang khras do shal/ nag khras ske rags gdu bu/༈ stag sham sbrul gyi chun pos dkris/ /nyams pa'i snying khrag hub kyis gsol/ /dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad ma la bstod/ /stobs bcu lus la rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /phyag g.yas ri rab sgong rdor 'phen/ /g.yon pa gling bzhi brla steng 'gying / /pad nyi zla steng bzhugs la bstod/ /rang mdangs me 'od kun tu 'phro/ /sprul pa'i ma mo las la 'gyed/ /dam nyams sgrol zhing bsgrub po skyong / /dge legs stsol mdzad ma la bstod/ /khyod ni srid pa'i ma mo ste/ /sgyu ma'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i tshe/ /res 'ga' stong khams khyab par sprul/ /res 'ga' sku gcig ma la bstod/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal mkha' klong na/ /ye shes dbyings kyi rje mo ste/ /bde gshegs spro dang sdud mdzad pa'i/ /a don skye med ma la bstod/ /nges don thig le gsang ba'i yum/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med gtso mo ste/ /bstan skyong rig 'dzin sring gcig ma/ /rdo rje re ma ti la bstod/ /kun rdzob 'jig rten klu mo dkar/ /klu chen brgyad kyi lcam mo ste/

/'dod dgu'i longs spyod char ltar 'bebs/ /klu rgyal lcam gcig ma la bstod/ /sngon tshe dpal chen padma 'byung / /'khon ston rnams kyis dam la btags/ /yang phur srung mar zhal gyis bzhes/ /dpal gri bstan skyong ma la bstod/ /bar du dpal chen pho brang du/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen drung / /khas blangs ji bzhin sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa bsrung mdzad ma la bstod/ /phyi rabs sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyi/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrubs/ /bla ma'i bka' srung ma la bstod/ /tha mar rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /bka' bsgo ji bzhin bdag cag la/ /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar dung / /'di phyi'i grogs mdzad ma la bstod/ /smra bsam brjod med rgyal ba'i yum/ /gdul bya 'dul phyir ma mo'i gzugs/ /gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa'i/ /las bzhi lhun grub ma la bstod/ /'khon ston klu dbang bsrung ba sogs/ /'khon rog yab mes srung ma khyod/ /'khon rigs bdag gis bstod pa'i mthus/ /'khon brgyud bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sa bstan gdung brgyud chos rgyun bcas/ /sa steng dar zhing rgyas gyur nas/ /sa gsum che rgu dbang du bsdus/ /sa chen 'gro kun mgon gyur mdzod/ /bdag gi tshe sogs legs tshogs spel/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /bdag don mthar phyin gzhan don 'grub/ /bdag 'dzin bdud dgra tshar gcod mdzod/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' lung ltar/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig bsrung ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang mngon gyur shog /ces rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srung dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa la bstod pa dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra las thig le gsang ba'i yum la bstod pa rab snyan ma mo'i 'gying glu zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /hūm̐/ rab 'jigs sku yi ༈ 'di'i shlau ka gcig la mi rtog ma 'bring po myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma'i dbyangs rol/

gsang ba rngam zhing brjid/ /rab drag gsung gi gsang ba sa gsum g.yo/ /rab gtum thugs kyi gsang ba snying rjes khros/ /gsang ba gsum bdag rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /bde stong rnam par mi rtog yi ge hūm̐/ /'od zhu gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i mgon po ni/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir rdo rje thod phreng can/ /khams gsum srog gi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /sngon tshe skye 'gro'i tshe srog 'phrog pa'i tshe/ /ston pas rgyu 'bras chos bshad dam la btags/ /dbang bskur dam tshig bsrung phyir thod phreng gtad/ /nyams pa'i khrag 'thung nag po khyod la bstod/ /'jigs rung mun pa 'bum las nag pa'i sku/ /gad rgyangs 'brug sgra 'bum las lhag pa'i gsung / /mngon spyod khro dbang 'bum las gnag pa'i thugs/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul stobs ldan khyod la bstod/ /tsaṇḍa mu kha mdog nag khro gnyer bsdus/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril spyan gsum bsgrad/ /dbu skra smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i mnga' bdag khyod la bstod/ /sbom thung yan lag rags shing gsus pa che/ /dar nag beng chen khrag 'dzag g.yang gzhi gyon/ /khrag zhag thig le thal chen tshom bus spras/ /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal byas/ /sbrul rus rgyu mas brgyan cing sag rb+pa gsol/ /ba spu'i khung nas me stag bu yug 'tshub/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor drag lha khyod la bstod/ /phyag g.yas lcags mdung sde brgyad dmag dpung sdud/ /g.yon pa thod phreng dam nyams tshe srog 'dren/ /rgyob sod hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro'i 'o dod 'bod/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srung ma khyod ma bstod/ /mig sman mdangs ldan stobs chen myur 'gro'i steng / /zhing chen gzar la rin chen sga yob gtad/ /sbrul nag srab smad brgyan pa chibs su chibs/ /snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon khyod la bstod/ /dus mtha'i me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong dkyil na/

/rang 'dra mched brgyad 'khor dang lhan cig rol/ /stong gsum nyul zhing dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol/ /nag phyogs lha min g.yul bzlog khyod la bstod/ /khyod ni bdud du sprul yang lha yi rje/ /res 'ga' tsandan beng chen klad la 'phyar/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i dge mtshan bsgreng / /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin khyod la bstod/ /khyod ni mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma ste/ /bstan dgra'i srog gcod sha phrag za zhing rngam/ /sprul pa'i pho nyas 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub/ /bdud mgon spu gri nag po khyod la bstod/ /khyod ni nyes legs btang 'dzin khrims pa ste/ /gdug can sgrol yang 'gro la bu ltar brtse/ /dpal chen thugs kyi pho nya mthu bo che/ /khro rgyal rdo rje dur khrod khyod la bstod/ /khyod ni rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung dbang po ste/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /thub bstan bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin dbu 'phang bstod/ /dam can rdo rje thod phreng khyod la bstod/ /phyi ltar rgyal ba'i bka' nyan bdud kyi gzugs/ //nang ltar zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i rigs/ /gsang ba ye shes lnga 'dus chos kyi dbyings/ /ngo mtshar chu zla'i rol rtsed khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'phrin las byed po khyod/ /dpal chen rnal 'byor bdag gis bstod pa'i mthus/ /dpal 'bar sa bstan gdung brgyud lha mi'i sde/ /dpal 'byor nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung nag po khyod/ /dus mthar brten cing sgrub pa'i dgos pa ni/ /dus kun sa bstan gnod byed snying gi khrag /chos skyong 'di bdud du sprul pa la gshin rje'i ming gis bos na mi 'gal lam snyam na mi 'gal te/ 'di'i bskang ba bsdus pa las/ bdud po ma rung gshin rje'i gzugs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/༈ dus dgra khyod kyi zhal du ku ṭa yaṃ/ /sngon tshe thub pa'i drung na lhas byin ltar/

/sngon las zhe sdang rang gzugs dgra bo 'dis/ /sngon byon gong ma'i bstan la mtho 'tshams byed/ /sngon gyi dam bcas ji bzhin myur du sgrol/ /byang chub snying po nges don rang gnas su/ /byang chub rim gnyis ting 'dzin bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /byang chub bar chad bsrung phyir khyod bskul lo/ /byang chub rdo rje gzhon nu mngon gyur shog /ces rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srung dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa la bstod pa dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra las bdud mgon thod phreng can la bstod pa 'jigs rung dpa' bo'i shug glu zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// bhyoḥ༈ 'di'i shlau ka gcig la gzhan yang ma 'bring po nam gru ma'i dbyangs rol/ nam gru nag mo re ma ṭi/ /me long sbrul zhags phur bu 'dzin/༈ lhan cig tu g.yas kyi 'dzin/ /gos nag rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /lcags kyi ༈ dri rta rkang gsum chibs la bstod/ /bstan srung ser nag re ma ṭa/ /g.yu zor gser gyi par bu 'dzin/ /rma bya'i mjug ma/༈ sgro thul rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /sha ba yu mo chibs la bstod/ /khrag 'thung dmar nag re ma dza/ /bandha khrag bkang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /ser khra/༈ re lde rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /chu glang nag po chibs la bstod/ /dam can ljang nag re ma dzu/ /khraṃ baṃ tshon gyi gru gu 'dzin/ /nag po/༈ dar chun rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /rnga mong gwa pa chibs la bstod/ /bdag nyid mched bzhi bstod pa'i mthus/ /sa bstan gdung brgyud lha mi'i sde/ /srid mthar 'phel zhing bdag cag gi /ci bsam don kun 'grub gyur cig /'di'i shlau ka gcig la shwa thung gi dbyangs rol/༈ bhyoḥ zangs kyi mi mo wa gdong dmar/ /gcer mo rdo rje phur pa 'dzin/ /spyi lhas/༈ ral gcig cod paṇa ༈ dar rus pa'i rgyan/ zangs/༈ /wa mo rkang gsum chibs la bstod/ /gser gyi mi mo 'phar gdong ser/

/gcer mo lcags kyu phur pa 'dzin/ /ral gcig cod paṇa rus pa'i brgyan/ /gser 'phar lce brgyad chibs la bstod/ /lcags kyi mi mo spyang gdong sngo/ /gcer mo thod dbyug phur pa 'dzin/ /ral gcig cod paṇa rus pa'i rgyan/ /lcags spyang mgo dgu chibs la bstod/ /g.yu yi mi mo khyi gdong mthing / /gcer mo gzhing ༈ byis ro chung phur bu 'dzin/ /ral gcig cod paṇa rus pas brgyan/ /g.yu khyi ral gcig chibs la bstod/ /shwa na mched bzhi bstod pa'i mthus/ /sa bstan gdung brgyud lha mi'i sde/ /srid mthar 'phel zhing bdag cag gi /ci bsam don kun 'grub gyur cig /bhyoḥ༈ 'di'i shlau ka gcig la gzhan yang ma thung ba dpal thung gi dbyangs rol/ bdud lcam spyi byin gcer mo nag /lcags ༈ rdo rje mtshan pa kyu phur 'dzin g.yu 'brug zhon/ /mthing nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /ku landha ri ༈ gsang mtshan khyod la bstod/ /gza' lcam ya byin gcer mo ser/ /zhags pa phur 'dzin chu srin zhon/༈ rin po che mtshan pa/ /ser nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /shu landha ri ༈ gsang mtshan khyod la bstod/ /btsan lcam bse byin gcer mo dmar/ /lcags sgrog phur 'dzin glog dmar zhon/ /dmar nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /tsa mundha ri ༈ gsang mtshan khyod la bstod/ /klu lcam phag byin gcer mo ljang / /dril bu phur 'dzin klu ra zhon/ /ljang nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /kam ka dha ri khyod la bstod/༈ gsang mtshan/ yang na 'di rnams phyag g.yas lcags kyu kho na mdog mthun gyi ber rda/ dbang gi bse khrab/ gser sogs kyi rna cha dar gyi cod paṇa 'phur ba'ang 'ga' zhig tu snang / /bse mo mched bzhi bstod pa'i mthus/ /sa bstan gdung brgyud lha mi'i sde/ /srid mthar 'phel zhing bdag cag gi /ci bsam don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa la bstod pa dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra las dam can bcu gnyis la bstod pa gnas gsum ḍā ki bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba'i le'u gsum pa'o/

/'dir smras pa/ drin zla med sa chen yab sras kyi/ /rgyun brten cing sgrub pa'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /dpal brtse chen snying po'i rdo rje'i bka'/ /kye ma brjid dran ran phur srung rnams/ /sngon gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dam chos dar/ /rgyal sprul pa du mas bde skyid spel/ /da glang dar bsam pa 'grub la nye/ /kye mthu stobs bskyed ran phur srung rnams/ /mi phal cher nor ldan blun po bkur/ /mchod 'os kun rgyab sgyur byed pa 'di/ /kho tshe lo bcu pa'i sta gon yin/ /kye thub bstan srung ran phur srung rnams/ /bstan dam chos skyong kun sprang po 'dra/ /sdig spyod kun bsgyur rgyal dpal la 'gran/ /bod gangs can skyid sdug e ma gzigs/ /kyai 'jig rten skyong ran phur srung rnams/ /lha mchog gsum bstan dang de 'dzin bcas/ /kha 'jam pos bslus nas shig byed kun/ /thabs zhi ba gsum gyis 'dul dka' bas/ /kyai da lta sgrol ran phur srung rnams/ /a deng sang lnga bdo rtags tsam 'dzin/ /dus ngan stabs bdud sprul mang 'phel yang / /de mi bsgrol bstan srung zhal bzhes pa'i/ /don ji ltar lags pa gsung du gsol/ /da 'on kyang ma rung sems can rnams/ /'das rgyal ba kun gyis ma thul ba'i/ /las ngan 'bras rang thog smin pa la/ /khyed dam can rgya mtsho ci zhig smod/ /rang gtor bsngo tsam yang mi 'bul zhing / /sngags dam tshig mtha' dag nyams bzhin du/ /zhe drag po'i tshig gis bstan skyong gshe/ /'di rgyal kun khrel ba'i rgyu min nam/ /skyabs bla mar dbang zhus dam tshig ldan/ /lha thugs bskul bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor brtson/ /dgra zhing bcu sgrol ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /las mngon spyod sgrub na ngo mtshar rmad/ /khong bstan bsrung rgya mtsho bstod dbyangs la/ /thugs dgyes pa'i gtam ༈ lo chen gyis mgon po la srin gzugs ma 'khyer bas zhal gzigs pa dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis pu ṭa'i bstod bskul bdud dpung kun 'joms ma mdzad pas pu tra nyid ban gzugs kyi tshul du zhal gzigs pa sogs mang /

rgyud 'phags bod kyi/ /mkhas grub brnyes kun gyis bsngags pa bzhin/ /kho bos rgyu mtshan shes nas tshul 'di sbyar/ /rje sngon byon gsung las bsnyen sgrub skabs/ /rtsom 'dod sogs bdud du gsungs mod kyang / /'dir chos skyong dges pa'i mtshan ma mthong /༈ rgyu mtshan zhib pa logs su 'bri bar bya'o/ /khyod bar chad nam mkha'i dbyings su phaṭaḥ /yang nyes tshogs mchis na bla ma lha/ /ma mkha' 'gro srung ma'i spyan snga ru/ /tshe sngon ma'i sdig dang lhan cig bshags/ /thugs brtse bas bdag la grub gnyis stsol/ /ngas 'di sbyar dge ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bstan nyi ma bstan 'dzin 'od zer 'phro/ /yongs bsod nams mkhar rgyu bde skyid gsal/ /bdud mun nag 'joms pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang sa smyon bhu su ku ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rang lo'i 'jal byed bcu phrag gnyis su gnyis kyis lhag pa 'phags yul legs sbyar skad du pra mā dī zhes pa rab myos su 'bod cing / stong khun gong ma chen po'i khab tu gin gu ces grags la/ bsil ldan phyag na padmo'i gdul bya'i zhing 'dir lcags pho rta'i lo/ gdan sa chen po'i dus rim phur bzlog gi zor 'dzin skabs sngon 'gro'i bsnyen sgrub kyi tshe chos skyong rnams la bstod pa zhig dgos pa'i mtshan ma yang yang mthong bas rkyen byas bod zla ba'i yar tshes bdun la res gza' gos sngon can lha mo rnams mjal ba'i 'grub 'byor bzang po'i nyin nas dbu btsugs te zhag gsum gyi bar la gung tshigs thun mtshams skabs tshogs 'khor la rol bzhin par dbang khang smin grol bde chen du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang gi gos 'dzin bsod 'od kyis bgyis pa// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
